And slowly, painfully slowly, things started to change.

Today, I'm not standing here to tell you I'm perfect or that I have all the answers. I'm here because I survived, I grew, and I want you to know that whatever you're facing right now – you can too. The person you're becoming through your struggles is worth every difficult moment.

Thank you.
